info.title: Lingopal API v2
info.description: Lingopal v2 public API for text translation, storage uploads, registered jobs, job workflows, and job outputs.

get.description: Returns language capabilities filtered by dubbing, text, or all supported workflows.

parameters.name: language_type

schema.description: Language capability filter: `dubbing` for media translation, `text` for text/document/subtitle workflows, or `all` for every supported language.
schema.title: Language Type

post.summary: Upload and register a small file
post.description: Uploads a small file directly to Lingopal and registers it as media or a document. For files larger than the direct upload limit, use `/v2/storage/uploads` multipart upload. Provide target languages and translation context later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

directVideoJobUpload.summary: Upload and register a small video file
directVideoJobUpload.description: Send the file bytes to Lingopal and receive a reusable job_id. Provide target languages later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

200.description: Registration result for the uploaded file.

403.description: Authentication credentials were not provided, or the authenticated account is restricted (detail.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED).

413.description: File exceeds the direct upload limit.

post.description: Registers one or more uploaded or externally hosted file URLs as Lingopal media/document records. This endpoint records source metadata only; processing inputs such as target languages and translation context are supplied later through the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint. Per-item failures are returned in the `results` array with `status="error"`.

registerSingleFile.description: Register a source_url from `/v2/storage/uploads` as a reusable Lingopal file. Use the returned job_id with `/v2/jobs/{job_id}/translations` or `/v2/jobs/{job_id}/subtitles` to start processing.

registerMixedFileBatch.description: Register several already-uploaded sources in one request. Upload endpoints do not accept target languages or translation context; provide those to the appropriate `/v2/jobs/{job_id}` workflow endpoint.

post.description: Returns one or more presigned S3 upload URLs for uploading a source file before registering it with `/v2/jobs/register`. Provide `file_size` to request a multipart upload.

singlePartStorageUpload.description: Request one presigned PUT URL for a client-managed source upload. Register the returned source_url later with `/v2/jobs/register`.

multipartStorageUpload.description: Request presigned part URLs for a large source upload. Complete the multipart upload with `/v2/storage/uploads/complete`, then register the returned source_url with `/v2/jobs/register`.

200.description: Presigned upload metadata and upload part URLs.

403.description: Authentication credentials were not provided, or the authenticated account is restricted (detail.code: ACCOUNT_RESTRICTED).

post.summary: Refresh presigned URLs for a multipart storage upload
post.description: Returns fresh presigned upload URLs for specific parts of an in-progress multipart upload created by `/v2/storage/uploads`. Use this to resume an upload after part URLs expire instead of restarting the whole upload. Only uploads owned by the authenticated user can be refreshed.

200.description: Fresh presigned upload URLs for the requested parts.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this resource.

post.summary: List parts of an in-progress multipart storage upload
post.description: Returns the parts of an in-progress multipart upload that S3 has confirmed, plus fresh presigned upload URLs for every part, so a client can resume an interrupted upload instead of restarting it. Only uploads owned by the authenticated user can be listed.

listMultipartStorageUploadParts.description: Look up which parts of an in-progress multipart upload S3 has confirmed and receive fresh presigned URLs for every part. Then register the returned source_url with `/v2/jobs/register` after completing the upload.

200.description: Confirmed parts and fresh presigned upload URLs.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this resource.

post.description: Completes an S3 multipart upload created by `/v2/storage/uploads`. Only uploads owned by the authenticated user can be completed.

completeMultipartStorageUpload.description: Finalize a multipart upload after every part has been uploaded to S3. Then register the returned source_url with `/v2/jobs/register`.

403.description: The authenticated user cannot access this resource.

request_type.title: Request Type
request_type.description: Language capability filter used for the response.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: One to 100 source text inputs to translate. When context is provided, each input accepts at most 4000 characters. Across the request, the sum of every text plus the repeated context accepts at most 10000 characters. Aliases accepted: `text`, `content`.

target_language.title: Target Language
target_language.description: Single target locale code. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported text translation languages. Alias accepted: `language`.

source_language.title: Source Language
source_language.description: Optional source locale code. Use `GET /v2/languages/text` to list supported text translation languages. If omitted, Lingopal may auto-detect it.

context.title: Context
context.description: Optional context to improve translation quality. Accepts at most 8000 characters.

message.description: Deployment name for the triggered workflow.

target_languages.title: Target Languages
target_languages.description: Locales included in the retry workflow.

reset.title: Reset

remove_background_audio.title: Remove Background Audio
